Rank 03 - Retail

Shop Ledger, Inventory, and Daily Profit

The shop owner needs to know today what was bought, sold, due, low-stock, and profitable.

Calculate revenue Open overview

Suggested package

BDT 5,000Installation/setup fee
BDT 200Recommended monthly charge

BDT 200/month can work only for local-only simple software. Cloud backup should be BDT 300-500/month.

9.2Practical score based on daily pain, willingness to pay, support load, and expansion potential.
BDT 5,000Default setup used in calculator.
BDT 200Suggested monthly price after support-cost thinking.
BDT 7,400,000Gross year-one revenue at 1,000 businesses.

Why this can work

Retail and repair are the largest block of Bangladesh economic units. Even 1,000 paying shops is a tiny penetration target.

Notebook records get lost, buying price is forgotten, and customer/supplier dues become unclear.

At night, the owner sees sale, due, stock, and profit.

Validation signals

  • Bangladesh has millions of small economic units.
  • Retail/repair is the largest segment.
  • Phone-loss fear makes cloud backup easy to explain.
  • Daily close can become a habit.

MVP modules

  • Product list
  • Purchase entry
  • Sale entry
  • Customer dues
  • Supplier dues
  • Daily close
  • Local backup and cloud upgrade

Do not build first

  • Do not call it accounting software.
  • Do not build broad ERP first.
  • Do not give unlimited support at BDT 100/month.

Money model

Change the inputs and see the business case instantly.

Use support cost as a reality check. Low monthly pricing looks attractive until support eats the margin.

First 30-day launch plan

  • Pick one bazar.
  • Install in 10 shops.
  • Import opening stock.
  • Make daily close the main habit.

Risks and fixes

Risks
  • Support can eat margin.
  • Wrong data entry reduces trust.
  • Churn after setup.
Mitigations
  • Annual prepaid.
  • CSV import and product templates.
  • Backup reminders.
